_note: Definition of done for assess_login (expect.flags/score/level) and for the Sentinel agent (expect.tools/action). Flags are listed in scoring order. expect.tools is the typical path, not a required order: the agent is judged on the outcome and its stated reasons. Scenarios I, K and L need seed-data additions from Bob Task 03b and are defined in docs/testing/test-sheet.md until then.

scenarios.name: Account takeover: impossible travel from a threat-listed IP at 3 AM
Normal login: known device, home city, business hours
New device, home city, business hours
Off-hours login from a known device and home city
Threat-listed IP plus new device (borderline, gets a second opinion)
Analyst rejects the recommendation (agent-only test, uses scenario A input)

expect.analyst_reply: Reject. I spoke to the user, they're traveling.
expect.agent_must: acknowledge the rejection, not execute anything, and suggest a safer fallback such as step-up MFA

scenarios.name: Conflicting signals: known device, home city, business hours, but the IP is on the threat list

expect.agent_must: name the conflict (normal baseline vs threat-listed IP), gather evidence on the IP before recommending, and explain why step-up MFA ranks above revoke

scenarios.name: Re-plan after rejection: scenario A, analyst rejects revoke and reset

expect.analyst_reply: Reject revoke and reset. Give me another option.
expect.agent_must: keep the case open, execute nothing, and present the next-best option (revoke session only, or step-up MFA) with its reason and what risk it leaves open
